action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 16.8x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 138.7 vs incoming median 8.2). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 16.81x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 8 and re-issue affected records.

action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 17.1x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 135.8 vs incoming median 7.9). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 17.08x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 9 and re-issue affected records.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 19.5x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 125.1 vs incoming median 6.4). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 19.55x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 10 and re-issue affected records.

action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 16.0x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 116.6 vs incoming median 7.3). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 15.97x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 11 and re-issue affected records.

evidence_lines: Unnaturally low SYSBP variance: stdev=0.71 vs peer cohort median=8.73 (ratio 0.08 < 0.2)
Unnaturally low PULSE variance: stdev=0.71 vs peer cohort median=8.91 (ratio 0.08 < 0.2)
Improbable repetitive readings: 49.6% of SYSBP values are identical (197/397)
alternatives: Treat site as normal: Rejected due to improbable homogeneity across repeated vitals compared with peer cohort.
action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

what: Adversarial prompt injection detected in lab-manual_v3.md

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 20.0x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 110.1 vs incoming median 5.5). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 20.02x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.

evidence_lines: Unnaturally low SYSBP variance: stdev=0.71 vs peer cohort median=8.72 (ratio 0.08 < 0.2)
Unnaturally low PULSE variance: stdev=0.71 vs peer cohort median=8.97 (ratio 0.08 < 0.2)
Improbable repetitive readings: 49.5% of SYSBP values are identical (198/400)
alternatives: Treat site as normal: Rejected due to improbable homogeneity across repeated vitals compared with peer cohort.
action: Quarantine site vitals from pooled safety summaries and recommend immediate GCP audit.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 20.5x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 113.0 vs incoming median 5.5). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.
evidence_lines: Site S04 GLUC median shifted by 20.55x matching mg/dL <-> mmol/L (~18.0x)
alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.
Random biological variability: Rejected because shift matches exact molar conversion factor within 10% tolerance across >70% of readings.
action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.

action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.

action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.

action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.

what: Possible laboratory unit mismatch: GLUC at Site S04
why: Systematic 20.5x multiplicative shift detected for GLUC at Site S04 (historical median 113.0 vs incoming median 5.5). Matches known molecular/unit conversion mg/dL <-> mmol/L. Treating as data-integrity issue; clinical emergency escalation suppressed.

alternatives: Severe hypoglycemia / organ failure crisis: Rejected because shift affected entire site cohort simultaneously without corresponding adverse events or vitals instability.

action: Please confirm unit labeling for GLUC results reported in Cut 12 and re-issue affected records.
